evidence: Judge agent and model are pinned once, in the frozen block: task.toml:30-35 `REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code"`, `REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx"`, OpenRouter base URL, `${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}` token, empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY - matches staged-task-contract.md exactly. All five judge.toml [judge] blocks carry only `judge = "claude-code"` fallback, mode, timeout, isolated, prompt_template and MCP servers; no model/temperature/reasoning_effort/weight (e.g. tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:1-18); a diff of each [judge]..[scoring] block against the frozen template is identical. Judge CLIs and browser pinned: tests/Dockerfile:16-22 `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281`, `@openai/codex@0.151.0`, `@playwright/mcp@0.0.79`, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1; :31 `harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7`; :33-38 Chromium installed by the playwright CLI bundled inside the pinned @playwright/mcp and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which every judge.toml passes via `--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium`. tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8...5fdd), test.sh, tools/score.py (13de2b38...), tools/restart_mcp.py (03c1426f...), scoring.toml, .dockerignore and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template, so the shared tools/ builds are canonical. test.sh refuses to grade without REWARDKIT_JUDGE/MODEL (lines 63-66) and runs rewardkit with --max-concurrent-agent 1 (line 207). Fixed clock: no graded rule depends on the calendar date. instruction.md, hireops_rules.md and integration.md contain no date-relative rule (no 'today', due dates, ages, expiry windows); the only time bound is the relative 15-second live-update window (rules section 5; functional criteria hro_live_board/hro_msg_exchange; polish criteria), which the functional prompt line 45 makes deterministic for the judge ('accept what is present at the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds'). Session end for drafts is triggered by sign-out in another tab (polish judge.toml:59), not by a timer. Seed timestamps are all fixed July 2026 values (2026-07-01..2026-07-29) and are not graded; golden orders messages/activity by autoincrement id (solution/app/src/index.js:189, 382-387), not wall clock. Because no graded time rule exists, the 'fixed clock' requirement is satisfied vacuously and no declared clock is needed. Per workbook D48 and quality-checks.md 47 Note, temperature/prompt-version markers are not required and public verifier network/no allowlist is not a defect; the Internal sheet's older 'temperature 0 / versioned prompt / no unpinned network' wording is superseded by the public row text and the skill's delivery profile, so not reported. Adversarial check: a broken app cannot exploit pinning (judge identity is not task-controllable; the agent image has no judge config). A conforming app that timestamps with its own clock and sorts by created_at would still order correctly because seeded data predates any current run (2026-10-03) - no wall-clock-dependent false failure found. Residual non-defects (template-controlled, identical to the frozen template, not task-authored and per AGENTS.md must be preserved): base images use tags not digests (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim), apt packages and npm/pip transitive deps are resolved at build time, and OpenRouter provider routing for the pinned model slug is not pinned. No full configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'), so judge run-to-run variability is unmeasured; that is a runtime-evidence gap owned by the workload/verifier-launch rows, not a pinning defect for this source-checkable row.
